title: Topic 20
japanese_text:
A：いたっ！
B：大丈夫？<u>応急</u> <u>処置する</u>から、切ったとこ見せて。うわ、痛そう…。ちょっと<u>染みる</u>と思うけど、我慢してね。あ、こっちは<u>痣</u>になりそうだね。ちょっと冷やしておこう。
english_translation: A: Ow! B: Are you okay? Let me see the cut, so I can give you first aid treatment . Oh, that looks painful ... It's going to sting a little, but please be tough. Oh, this one looks like it might bruise. Let's cool it down a bit.
